game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge, a bridge of fixed ropes: the ice axe ranger must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge: a bridge of fixed ropes
core_gameplay_loop: In Sherpa Bridge, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round, a new oxygen tanks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the vowels value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of oxygen tanks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sherpa Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Sherpa Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
